secrets.stageSecretContract: Stage receives no secrets: no platformx.env mount, no env_file, no Telegram, model, GitHub or dashboard secrets. Internal health validation does not need them.

legacyEnvExclusion.envFilePolicy: /opt/data/.env is allowed only as a regular file with no non-empty value for a secrets.forbiddenProductionSecretClasses key. The upstream image creates .env on first boot (stage2-hook.sh seed_one .env.example, then a generated API_SERVER_KEY), so refusing on existence would restart-loop stage.
legacyEnvExclusion.reason: Stage state snapshots must not carry production or legacy Hermes secrets (a copied live Telegram token would 409 the live bot); on every start the stage entrypoint guard fails closed with exit 78 on .op.env, a symlinked .env, or a .env holding a forbidden secret class.
